Title: Address displays on Contact Us page
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running via "streamlit run ui/app.py"
Steps: 1. Launch the app | 2. In the sidebar, select "Contact Us" | 3. Observe the page content
Expected Result: The Contact Us page shows Radhika Yadgire's Phone, Email, and a new Address field with value "ABC park, Pune"

Title: Navigate from Home to Contact Us and verify full contact block
Preconditions: App is running and Home page is loaded by default
Steps: 1. Launch the app (Home page loads by default) | 2. Click "Contact Us" in the sidebar navigation | 3. Verify all contact fields (Phone, Email, Address) render together in order
Test Data: Phone: 1234567 | Email: radhika@gmail.com | Address: ABC park, Pune
Expected Result: User can navigate from Home to Contact Us and see Phone, Email, and Address rendered together without errors

Title: Address label renders correctly when browser window is resized/narrow
Steps: 1. Open Contact Us page | 2. Resize browser window to a narrow/mobile width | 3. Observe the Address line wrapping and label formatting
Expected Result: The "**Address:**" bold label and value remain fully visible and readable without being cut off or overlapping other fields

Title: Address text matches JIRA MT-4 specification exactly
Steps: 1. Open Contact Us page | 2. Read the Address field value | 3. Compare it character-for-character against the JIRA MT-4 description
Expected Result: Displayed address text exactly matches "ABC park, Pune" with no typos, extra spaces, or missing comma

Title: Address field does not appear on Home page
Steps: 1. Launch the app so the Home page loads | 2. Do not navigate to Contact Us | 3. Search the Home page content for any address text
Expected Result: The Home page does not display the Address, Phone, or Email fields since those belong only to the Contact Us page
